name: Cosmic Common
description: Generic, reusable LangFlow custom components for the Cosmic AR Agent — document readers (Excel/CSV/PDF), a document classifier, an Excel normalizer, business-rule/validation/calculation engines, an invoice builder, a Zoho connector, an audit logger, a notification component, and checkpoint/state/configuration managers. These are the generic reusable layer that the AR-specific ar_common and ar_tools bundles compose (constitution §15).
